pages.en:
Perhaps the tension holding me together snapped when Tohsaka left.

My feverish body suddenly feels leaden, and I lie down where I am in the living room.

“——”

I stay on my side and wait for the returning nausea to pass.

My body feels dull, so I lay down in the living room.
“”

I still don't understand what that really means.

All I know for certain is that it is beyond me.

If I had even the slightest interest in the Holy Grail, perhaps it would feel more real—

“Why is it? All I feel toward the Holy Grail is disgust.”

A cup said to grant wishes.

I don't know what manner of thing it is, but it must be a sacred relic of tremendous power if it can summon beings like Servants.

A grail said to make wishes come true.
I don’t know what kind of a thing it is, but it’s an artifact that can even summon these things called Servants.

And yet—I have no interest in such a thing.

Partly because it feels unreal, leaving me doubtful it even exists. But more than that, a shortcut like that simply feels like cheating.

その、押し退ける方法によっては、無関係な人々にまで危害を加える事になる。

pages.en:
“And choosing its owner through a fight makes it even worse.”

…But this is a game of musical chairs.

Whatever your intentions, once you enter, you must force the others aside to survive.

And depending on how a participant chooses to do that, innocent people may be harmed as well.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“And the worst aspect of this thing is that the selection method is a battle.”
…But this is a fight for a single chair.
No matter what your expectations are, as long as you enter it, you can’t survive unless you defeat your enemies.
And depending on your methods, defeating other Masters might result in harm to innocent people.

君の望みは、ようやく叶う。
どんな手を使っても勝ち残ろうとするヤツを、なんとしてでも止める事。

Therefore—

—Rejoice, Shirou Emiya.

My reason to fight is not to emerge victorious from the Holy Grail War.

—Your wish will at last be granted.

It is to stop, by any means necessary, those who would do anything to win.
pages.mirrorMoon:
That’s why…
Rejoice, Emiya Shirou.
My reason for fighting is not to win the Holy Grail War.
Your wish will finally come true.
It is to stop those that would try to win it by any means possible.

“——”

Another wave of dizziness strikes.

Of course it does.

My body may look whole again, but only a few hours ago it was nearly cut in two.

There is no reason I should recover immediately. Frankly, it would be easier to believe I would remain like this for the rest of my life.

“!”

It’s only natural.
Even if it appears to be back to normal, my body was almost split in half a few hours ago.
There’s no way this sickness will go away quickly. It seems more likely that it’ll continue for the rest of my life.

彼女は、そんな俺を守るために傷を負った。

I nearly died three times in a single day.

Those without power cannot enter a battle and expect to go unhurt.

I nearly lost my body as the price of my own inadequacy.

And she was wounded protecting me from it.

As compensation for my lack of strength, I almost lost my body…
And she was wounded protecting me.

“Damn it, Tohsaka! You left out the one thing that mattered…!”

I force my resting body to its feet.

Tohsaka said nothing about Saber. She told me the two of them carried me home, then offered no further explanation.

There was one question I should have asked before any other: whether the girl Berserker wounded was safe.

Tohsaka didn’t say anything about Saber.
She said she and Saber brought me here, but she said nothing more.
The fact I need to know most: if she, the one wounded by Berserker, is all right or not.
